newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Pacific denies Australia expansion report.
newsitem.headline: Pacific denies Australia expansion report.

text.p: New Zealand's Pacific Retail Group on Wednesday rejected reports that it may soon enter Australia and had plans to market financial services.
"There has been media comment that Pacific Retail Group may soon enter Australia and that financial services would soon be marketed. This is incorrect," the company said in a statement.

"The company is and will be, for some time, totally focussed on further increasing the profitability of its three chains, Bond & Bond, Computer City and Noel Leeming, in the New Zealand market place."
The company said rationalisation and integration issues arising from last year's merger between Noel Leeming and Bond & Bond had been successfully addressed and were well advanced.
"Securitisation of the company's hire purchase receivables was finally achieved, immediately prior to Christmas, and the ongoing gains forecast from that are being achieved.
"The company will for the foreseeable future confine its finance activities to hire purchase funding only.
"It will however later evaluate the practicality and profitability of providing consumer hire purchase funding to other durables retailers," the statement said.

Once satisfied with the performance of the three chains, it said the company would consider longer-term direction. Expansion into other markets was only one of a number of alternatives which would be considered.
It said the company would update the market on current performance toward the end of next month.
